query: SELECT pm.id, p.name as plant_name, m.name as molecule_name, pm.percentage_min, pm.percentage_max, pm.percentage_typical, pm.role FROM plant_molecules pm JOIN plants p ON pm.plant_id = p.id JOIN molecules m ON pm.molecule_id = m.id ORDER BY p.name, pm.role;
